summary: Tested 3 reported Job OS regressions. All fixes verified working correctly: (1) Vendor consolidation - charges per unit NOT doubled when same item outsourced twice to same supplier, (2) DC print format - 9-col format for Job OS only (isJobOS = dc.lines empty), 6-col for standard SC, (3) Manufacturing Job Card - Stop/Complete buttons hidden for outsourced ops, yellow badge 'Outsourced — Receive via GRN' shown instead.
seed_data_creation: Created test items, suppliers, routings, BOMs, POs, WOs for consolidation testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Job OS regression fixes verified: (1) Backend consolidation logic at lines 4380-4460 correctly sums quantities without doubling charges per unit, (2) Frontend printDC at lines 254-395 uses isJobOS = !dc.lines || dc.lines.length === 0 to conditionally render 9-col vs 6-col format, (3) ManufacturingPage.js lines 1419-1442 correctly hides Stop/Complete for op.is_job_work === true and shows badge instead.
